text_block_list.text:
One day, the photo shoot for the magazine 
feature "Beauty Sasami's World of Racing 
Racewear" was underway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the bike for the shoot is brought 
in. All that's left is to change—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what're you standing around spacing 
out for? Your shoot starts in the 
afternoon too, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm not spacing out or anything! I'm just 
watching the photoshoot, look!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, smooth sailing so far! It's all 
thanks to you guys sticking with me!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
It's an honor to do a shoot with you! We 
were just worried we'd drag you down...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! You've got me 
in your corner, relax!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~!! That's fantastic! I'll take that 
smile!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-san looks even more radiant than 
she did during the test shoot...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To change that much... Has she already 
conquered her fear of 'cute'?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
From an outsider's point of view, it 
totally looks like she 'overcame' it, huh. 
I used to be on that side of thinking too, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Dad, you're always completely 
wrapped around Mom's little finger, aren't 
ya?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It just doesn't feel like the cool, rugged 
dad I know... Don't ya ever wanna talk 
back once in a while?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Being wrapped around her finger is 
totally fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Father
text_block_list.text:
If doing that keeps the family happy and 
brings a smile to the woman I love, isn't 
that the coolest damn thing in the world?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Father
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Vodka. It doesn't matter one bit 
what other people think. What matters is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Father
text_block_list.text:
What you think of yourself. Ain't that 
right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Vodka? What's with that smug grin on 
your face?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, nothin' really~

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Senpai! We were just talking about 
you! You're totally different today 
compared to the test shoot!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right? Being my natural self with 
my juniors like that... that's what I 
consider my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So you had it in you all along... As 
expected of Hishi Ama-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...The one who helped me realize it was 
you. Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aw, come on, I didn't really do 
anything...! But—... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You look totally stunning, Hishi 
Ama-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...Hehehe!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, nailed it... Totally struck a killer 
chord there...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...If only you didn't always have to add 
that extra unnecessary comment.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! Sh-Shut up!!

A few days later, browsing a bookstore 
magazine special... I found myself utterly 
captivated by the dazzling photos of the 
Muses shining on the pages.
